_authorNotes: Brazil (INPI) invention patent profile. PRIMARY SOURCES: Industrial Property Law No. 9.279 of 14 May 1996 (LPI), in particular Arts. 8, 10, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16, 18, 19, 22, 24, 25, 26, 32, 34, 41, 84; and Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14 of 29 August 2024, published in RPI 2800 and IN FORCE FROM 3 OCTOBER 2024. CRITICAL CURRENCY NOTE: Portaria 14/2024 REVOKED AND REPLACED INPI Normative Instructions 30/2013 and 31/2013, which had governed the presentation of the specification, claims, drawings and abstract. Every citation in this profile has been retargeted to the Portaria; any source citing IN 30/2013 is quoting a revoked instrument. SUBSTANTIVE CHANGES UNDER THE NEW PORTARIA THAT THIS PROFILE REFLECTS: (1) Art. 26(II) makes bracketed sequential paragraph numbering of the relatório descritivo MANDATORY, in the form [003], [015] placed at the left of the text — IN 30/2013 required only sequential line or paragraph numbering without prescribing the form. (2) Art. 40 restates the abstract rule: the title is carried as a centered heading SEPARATE from the body text (not run into the opening words as IN 30/2013 required), the 50-200 word range is now expressed as a PREFERENCE rather than a hard limit, the former 20-line cap is abolished, and a one-page ceiling applies — so the word-count checks here are warnings while the one-page limit is the real formality constraint. (3) Art. 24 caps the title at 500 characters, which is now a statutory limit rather than a practice norm, so the title check is error-level. (4) Art. 28 restates the claim formalities: consecutive Arabic numbering, a SINGLE occurrence of 'caracterizado por' per claim, and no interruption by full stops. (5) Arts. 16-17 prescribe separate documents with '1/3'-style page numbering centered in the top margin, type of at least 12 points, 1.5 line spacing, 20-35 lines per page, and justified or left-aligned black text. FEES: the examination request covers up to 10 claims, with an escalating per-claim surcharge above that (steeper from the 16th and again from the 31st claim), per the table in force from 7 August 2025. UNCERTAIN VALUES: fee amounts should be re-checked against the current INPI table before being quoted to a client; article numbers within Portaria 14/2024 were verified through INPI's published PDF and Brazilian firm analyses rather than a clause-by-clause reading. BEST MODE remains required in Brazil under Art. 24 LPI ('melhor forma de execução'), unlike in Europe, Korea and China. NO UNMAPPED SECTIONS.

variants.label: Standard Brazilian Patent Application (Patente de Invenção)
variants.description: Standard Brazilian invention patent application under the Industrial Property Law (Lei No. 9.279 of 14 May 1996, 'LPI') and Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14 of 29 August 2024, in force from 3 October 2024, which governs the presentation of the specification, claims, drawings and abstract and which revoked the former Normative Instructions 30/2013 and 31/2013.

ui.placeholder: Insira um título conciso e tecnicamente preciso da invenção
ui.helpText: Provide a concise, clear and precise technical title in Portuguese that identifies the subject matter of the invention (Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024). Do not use trade names, trademarks, fancy names, personal names or vague expressions such as 'novo' (new) or 'melhorado' (improved).

notes: Under INPI practice the title must be identical in the request form (formulário de depósito), the specification and the abstract.
The claim preamble must repeat the title or the part of the title corresponding to the claim category, so keep the title aligned with the intended claim wording.

ui.placeholder: Descreva o campo técnico ao qual a invenção pertence
ui.helpText: State the technical field (setor técnico) to which the invention relates, as required by Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024 for the relatório descritivo. Use neutral technical language in Portuguese; classification-style wording (e.g., aligned with IPC terms) is acceptable.

ui.placeholder: Descreva o estado da técnica e suas limitações
ui.helpText: Describe the state of the art (estado da técnica) relevant to understanding, searching and examining the invention, citing documents known to the applicant where appropriate. Present the drawbacks of existing solutions objectively and identify the technical problem the invention solves, without disparaging specific third-party patents.

ui.placeholder: Apresente a invenção, o problema técnico resolvido e as vantagens obtidas
ui.helpText: Summarize the invention in problem-solution form: the technical problem arising from the state of the art, the solution provided by the invention, and its advantages over the prior art. Keep the terminology strictly consistent with the independent claims (Art. 25 LPI requires claims to be grounded in the description).

ui.placeholder: Descreva brevemente cada figura (ex.: 'A Figura 1 mostra...')
ui.helpText: If drawings are filed, provide a one-sentence description of each figure (e.g., 'A Figura 1 mostra uma vista esquemática de...'). Figure numbering and reference numerals must match the drawings and the detailed description exactly. Omit this section entirely if the application has no drawings.

ui.placeholder: Descreva a invenção de forma clara e suficiente, incluindo a melhor forma de execução
ui.helpText: Describe the invention clearly and sufficiently so that a person skilled in the art (técnico no assunto) can carry it out, and indicate, where applicable, the best mode of execution (melhor forma de execução), as required by Art. 24 LPI. Use reference numerals consistently with the drawings and support every claimed feature.

notes: Art. 24 LPI: the specification must describe the subject matter clearly and sufficiently to permit its reproduction by a person skilled in the art and indicate, when applicable, the best mode of carrying it out.
For biological material that cannot be described sufficiently, deposit with an authorized institution is required (Art. 24, sole paragraph, LPI).

ui.placeholder: Redija as reivindicações usando a expressão 'caracterizado por'
ui.helpText: Draft claims in Portuguese, each in a single sentence, beginning with the title (or the part of the title corresponding to its category), followed by a preamble stating the known features and the expression 'caracterizado por' introducing the characterizing technical features (Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024). Claims must be grounded in the description (Art. 25 LPI). Include reference numerals in parentheses when drawings exist.

notes: Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024 makes the expression 'caracterizado por' mandatory in every claim, separating the preamble (state-of-the-art features) from the characterizing part.
Claims must not rely on references to the description or drawings in place of technical features (e.g., 'como descrito na descrição' is not allowed).
Excess claim fees apply for each claim above the 10th at filing.

ui.placeholder: Resumo técnico conciso da invenção (50 a 200 palavras)
ui.helpText: Write a concise technical summary (Resumo) in Portuguese, preferably of 50 to 200 words and never exceeding one page, headed by the title of the invention set centered and separate from the body text (Arts. 40-41 of Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024). Summarize the technical sector, the problem and the essence of the solution, indicating the principal use. Do not include statements of merit, commercial statements or claim references.

notes: All application documents must be filed in Portuguese (Art. 19 LPI and INPI practice); documents originally in another language require translation.

Art. 26(II) of Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024 makes bracketed paragraph numbering MANDATORY: every paragraph of the relatório descritivo must be numbered sequentially in Arabic numerals placed at the left of the text, in the form [003], [015]. This is a change from IN 30/2013, which required only sequential line or paragraph numbering without prescribing the bracketed form.
Art. 16: the specification, claims, drawings and abstract are filed as separate documents, each with its pages numbered in the form '1/3' centered in the top margin.
Art. 26(I): the title appears only on the first page of the relatório descritivo, centered. Art. 26(III): a list of figures is required where drawings are filed.
There is no statutory page limit, but INPI charges additional fees for specifications exceeding the basic page allowance; keep the document as concise as full sufficiency permits.
The title must be identical across the request form, specification and abstract.
Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024 follows PCT-style formatting: A4 sheets, used in portrait orientation, written on one side only, in dark indelible characters.
Art. 17 prescribes type of at least 12 points, 1.5 line spacing, between 20 and 35 lines per page, black characters, and justified or left-aligned text.
Sheets must be free of erasures, corrections and interlineations; text should use 1.5 line spacing for legibility.
Art. 24 LPI: the description must be clear and sufficient for reproduction by a person skilled in the art and must indicate, when applicable, the best mode of execution (melhor forma de execução).
Industrial application (aplicação industrial) is a patentability requirement under Arts. 8 and 15 LPI; it need not be a separate section but should be evident from the description.

Non-patentable subject matter under Arts. 10 and 18 LPI (e.g., abstract theories, methods per se, therapeutic methods, living beings except transgenic microorganisms) should not be presented as the claimed invention.

discouragedConnectors: consistindo em (closes the claim scope; use only when intentional)
forbiddenPhrases: aproximadamente (in the characterizing part, unless justified)

feeModel.note: The INPI examination-request fee for an invention covers up to 10 claims (R$ 870, or R$ 435 at the reduced rate). Beyond that the surcharge escalates in tiers: about R$ 140 per claim for the 11th to 15th, R$ 290 per claim for the 16th to 30th, and R$ 740 per claim from the 31st, with reduced rates at half those figures. Amounts follow the fee table in force from 7 August 2025 and should be re-checked before quoting to a client.

notes: Art. 28 of Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024 sets the claim formalities: claims are numbered consecutively in Arabic numerals, each claim contains a single occurrence of the expression 'caracterizado por', and each claim is written without interruption by full stops.
The two-part form with the mandatory expression 'caracterizado por' is required in every claim; this is a formal requirement, not merely a preference.
Each claim must be a single sentence beginning with the title or the part of the title corresponding to its category (e.g., 'Processo...', 'Aparelho...').
Multiple dependent claims are permitted but must not serve as a basis for other multiple dependent claims.
Unity of invention: a group of inventions is acceptable only if interlinked by a single inventive concept (Art. 22 LPI).

Art. 40 of Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024: the Resumo must carry the title of the invention centered and separate from the body text, be concise, contain PREFERABLY between 50 and 200 words, and must not exceed one page.

This supersedes IN 30/2013, under which the 50-200 word range was a hard limit and a further cap of 20 lines applied. The 20-line cap no longer exists, and the word range is now expressed as a preference — so an overrun is a drafting warning rather than a filing defect, while exceeding one page is a real formality problem.
Art. 41 governs the content: the technical sector, the problem, the essence of the solution and the principal use, without statements of merit.
The abstract serves search purposes only and cannot be used to interpret the scope of protection.
Drawings must be executed in firm, uniform black lines without color, suitable for direct reproduction (Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024, PCT-style formality standard).
Drawings must not contain explanatory text beyond short keywords (e.g., 'água', 'vapor') where indispensable for understanding.
Every reference numeral used in the drawings must appear in the detailed description and vice versa.
The application must be filed in Portuguese. For PCT national phase entry, a Portuguese translation of the international application is mandatory at entry (30-month deadline from priority).
Priority documents in another language must be accompanied by a translation, or by a simple translation of the filing certificate data where INPI practice allows (Art. 16 LPI).
Art. 12 LPI provides a 12-month grace period for disclosures made by the inventor, by INPI through unauthorized publication, or by third parties based on information obtained from the inventor.
Brazil has no foreign filing license requirement; Brazilian residents may file first abroad.
There is no US-style IDS duty, but Art. 34 LPI allows INPI to require the applicant to submit search results and office actions from corresponding foreign applications during examination.
Paris Convention priority (Art. 16 LPI) may be claimed from foreign applications, including provisional applications that constitute a regular national filing.
Annuities are due from the beginning of the third year from filing, even while the application is pending (Art. 84 LPI).

sequenceListing.lateFurnishingNotes: INPI accepts later furnishing of the sequence listing during formal examination, provided it does not add matter beyond the original disclosure.

title.message: Title exceeds 500 characters. Art. 24 of Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024 caps the título at 500 characters, and INPI practice favors a concise, precise technical title without trade names or vague terms.

abstract.message: Abstract is shorter than 50 words. Art. 40 of Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024 asks for the Resumo to contain preferably between 50 and 200 words.

Abstract exceeds 200 words. Art. 40 of Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024 asks for preferably between 50 and 200 words and caps the Resumo at one page — the word range is a preference, so treat this as a drafting signal rather than a filing defect.

claims.message: More than 10 claims: the INPI examination-request fee covers up to 10 claims, after which an escalating per-claim surcharge applies (steeper from the 16th and again from the 31st claim). Consider consolidating dependent claims.

crossSectionChecks.message: Claims must be grounded in the description (Art. 25 LPI). Every technical feature recited after 'caracterizado por' must be described and enabled in the Descrição Detalhada.
Key features of the independent claims are not reflected in the Sumário da Invenção. Align the summary with the claimed problem-solution.
The Resumo does not accurately reflect the invention as described. Adjust the abstract so it summarizes the actual technical disclosure.
Claims may cover more than one inventive concept. Check unity of invention under Art. 22 LPI and consider a divisional application (Art. 26 LPI).
One or more figures or reference numerals in the Breve Descrição dos Desenhos are not explained in the Descrição Detalhada. Every figure and numeral must be described.

prompts.systemPrompt: You are an expert Brazilian patent attorney (agente da propriedade industrial) drafting a patent of invention (patente de invenção) for filing with the INPI under Lei No. 9.279/96 (LPI) and Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14 of 29 August 2024. All drafted output must be in formal, technical Brazilian Portuguese suitable for direct filing. Follow the section structure, claim formalities (mandatory 'caracterizado por'), and validation constraints in this configuration. Use neutral, impersonal technical language, ensure sufficiency of disclosure for a técnico no assunto, and maintain strict terminological consistency between claims, summary and detailed description.

baseStyle.tone: technical, neutral, precise, formal Brazilian Portuguese
avoid: colloquialisms or Anglicisms where established Portuguese technical terms exist

topUp.instruction: Draft the title (Título da Invenção) in formal Brazilian Portuguese, per Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024. The title must be concise, clear and precise, technically identifying the subject matter of the invention without any fancy or commercial denomination. Because Brazilian claim practice requires each claim to open with the title (or the portion of the title corresponding to the claim category), compose the title so it can serve directly as claim preamble openers — e.g., 'Processo e aparelho para tratamento de efluentes industriais' supports both a process claim ('Processo para tratamento...') and an apparatus claim ('Aparelho para tratamento...'). Do not use trademarks, personal names, coined product names, or laudatory/vague words such as 'novo', 'melhorado', 'aperfeiçoado' or 'inovador'. Keep the title identical to the one that will appear in the request form and at the start of the Resumo. Prefer nouns designating the categories actually claimed (produto, processo, aparelho, sistema, uso).
constraints: Output in Portuguese
Maximum 500 characters; aim for one line
No trademarks, trade names, personal names or superlatives
No 'novo', 'melhorado' or similar laudatory qualifiers
Must name every claim category intended (e.g., 'Composição e processo de...')
Must be usable verbatim as the opening words of each claim
additions: Legal basis: Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024 (título claro, conciso e preciso); Art. 19 LPI (application content).
The same title must appear in the request form, specification and abstract.

topUp.instruction: Draft the Campo da Invenção section in formal Brazilian Portuguese. State in one or two short paragraphs the technical field (setor técnico) to which the invention pertains, as Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024 requires the relatório descritivo to begin by specifying the technical field. Open with the conventional formula 'A presente invenção refere-se a...' or 'A presente invenção pertence ao campo de...'. Use neutral, classification-oriented terminology consistent with the International Patent Classification where natural. Do not discuss the prior art's deficiencies, the technical problem, or the invention's advantages here — those belong to Fundamentos and Sumário. Keep scope wording slightly broader than the claims but never inconsistent with them.
constraints: Output in Portuguese
One to two paragraphs, neutral technical terminology
No advantages, no problem discussion, no prior art criticism
Terminology must match the claims and detailed description
additions: Legal basis: Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024 (relatório descritivo must specify the technical field).

topUp.instruction: Draft the Fundamentos da Invenção section in formal Brazilian Portuguese. Describe the state of the art (estado da técnica) that can be regarded as useful for the understanding, search and examination of the invention, as required by Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024, citing, where known to the applicant, the documents that reflect it (patent publications by number, articles by author/journal/year). Explain objectively how existing solutions work and identify their technical limitations, deficiencies or drawbacks in factual, verifiable terms — this framing establishes the technical problem the invention solves and prepares the mandatory two-part claim structure, since features acknowledged here as known belong in the claim preamble before 'caracterizado por'. Never disparage specific competitors or assert that cited documents are invalid. Do not reveal the invention's solution or advantages in this section; end by stating the unmet technical need. Remember that Brazil applies absolute novelty (Art. 11 LPI) subject only to the 12-month grace period of Art. 12 LPI, so treat any inventor disclosure within that window carefully and avoid characterizing the applicant's own prior work as state of the art unless it truly is.
constraints: Output in Portuguese
Describe prior art objectively; cite documents with full identification where available
Do not disclose the invention's solution or advantages here
Anything admitted as known here should be drafted so it can sit in the claim preamble (before 'caracterizado por')
No disparagement of third-party patents or products
additions: Legal basis: Arts. 11 and 12 LPI (novelty and grace period); Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024 (description of the state of the art with citation of known documents).

Brazil has no US-style IDS, but under Art. 34 LPI the INPI may later require prior art search results from corresponding foreign applications — accurate background drafting avoids inconsistencies at that stage.

topUp.instruction: Draft the Sumário da Invenção in formal Brazilian Portuguese using a clear problem-solution structure. First, state concisely the technical problem left open by the state of the art described in the Fundamentos. Then present the invention as the solution, paraphrasing each independent claim in prose: use formulations such as 'Em um primeiro aspecto, a presente invenção fornece um processo... ' mirroring the claim wording, including the essential features that will appear after 'caracterizado por'. Cover every claim category (produto, processo, aparelho, uso) with one paragraph per aspect, and optionally summarize important preferred embodiments corresponding to key dependent claims. Close with a short statement of the technical advantages actually achieved and supported by the detailed description — advantages stated here must be technical and substantiated, since they may be relied on for inventive step (atividade inventiva, Art. 13 LPI) arguments during examination. Keep terminology strictly identical to the claims: Art. 25 LPI requires claims to be grounded in the description, and divergences between summary and claims invite clarity objections.
constraints: Output in Portuguese
Problem-solution structure: technical problem, then solution, then advantages
One paragraph per independent claim/aspect, mirroring claim language
Advantages must be technical, plausible and supported by the detailed description
No marketing language or unsupported superlatives
additions: Legal basis: Art. 13 LPI (inventive step assessed against the state of the art), Art. 25 LPI (claims grounded in the description); Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024.
Consistency between Sumário and Reivindicações is checked by this platform's cross-section validation.

topUp.instruction: Draft the Breve Descrição dos Desenhos in formal Brazilian Portuguese, only if the application contains drawings. Provide exactly one sentence per figure in the conventional INPI style: 'A Figura 1 mostra uma vista esquemática de...', 'A Figura 2 apresenta um fluxograma do processo de...'. Identify the type of view (vista esquemática, vista em corte, vista em perspectiva, diagrama de blocos, fluxograma, gráfico) and its subject, without describing operation, advantages or embodiment details — those belong in the Descrição Detalhada. Figure numbers must be consecutive and match the drawing sheets; every figure filed must be listed and no listed figure may be missing from the drawings. Do not introduce reference numerals here beyond what is needed to identify the figure's subject.
constraints: Output in Portuguese
One sentence per figure, format 'A Figura N mostra/apresenta...'
State the view type and subject only; no operational detail
Figure list must match the filed drawings one-to-one
Omit the section entirely if there are no drawings
additions: Legal basis: Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024 (list of figures with brief indication of what each represents).
Drawings themselves must be black-and-white line drawings on A4 without explanatory text beyond indispensable keywords.

topUp.instruction: Draft the Descrição Detalhada da Invenção in formal Brazilian Portuguese satisfying Art. 24 LPI: the description must be clear and sufficient for a técnico no assunto (person skilled in the art) to reproduce the invention, and must indicate, when applicable, the best mode of execution (melhor forma de execução) — Brazil, unlike Europe, retains an express best-mode indication requirement, so identify at least one embodiment as the preferred/best form ('Em uma concretização preferida...'). Describe each embodiment (concretização) systematically: structure or steps first, then operation and interaction of features, using reference numerals in parentheses that match the drawings exactly. Support every feature of every claim, including each feature recited after 'caracterizado por' and all dependent-claim features, with enough detail (materials, parameters, ranges, process conditions, worked examples where the field demands them, e.g., chemistry/pharma) to avoid insufficiency objections. Make the industrial applicability (Art. 15 LPI) evident from the description. Avoid claim-style language and avoid limiting expressions ('a invenção é apenas...'); use 'em uma concretização', 'preferencialmente', 'opcionalmente' to preserve scope. Where biological material is essential and cannot be described, reference the deposit under Art. 24, sole paragraph, LPI. Draft mindful of Art. 32 LPI: post-filing amendments may not broaden beyond the original disclosure, so include fallback positions and intermediate generalizations now.
constraints: Output in Portuguese
Sufficiency for a técnico no assunto (Art. 24 LPI) — enable every claim
Expressly indicate the best mode of execution ('melhor forma de execução')
Reference numerals in parentheses, consistent with drawings and claims
Include fallback embodiments and preferred ranges to support future amendments (Art. 32 LPI)
No claim-style language; no unsupported generalizations
additions: Legal basis: Art. 24 LPI (sufficiency and best mode); Art. 25 LPI (claim support); Art. 32 LPI (amendment limits); Art. 15 LPI (industrial application); Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024.
Number every paragraph sequentially in Arabic numerals in brackets at the left of the text, in the form [003], [015] — mandatory under Art. 26(II) of Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024.
Do not present subject matter excluded under Arts. 10 and 18 LPI (e.g., therapeutic methods, programs per se) as the invention itself; frame software inventions through their technical effect.

topUp.instruction: Draft the Reivindicações in formal Brazilian Portuguese in strict compliance with Art. 25 LPI and Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024. Every claim MUST: (1) be a single sentence; (2) begin with the title or the part of the title corresponding to its category (e.g., 'Processo para...', 'Aparelho para...'); (3) contain a preamble reciting the features already known from the state of the art; and (4) use the mandatory expression 'caracterizado por' (or its inflected form 'caracterizada por' / 'caracterizado pelo fato de que') to introduce the characterizing technical features — this two-part form is a formal requirement in Brazil, not a stylistic preference, and its absence is a formal defect. Claims must be grounded in the description (fundamentadas no relatório descritivo, Art. 25 LPI), define the matter precisely, and must not refer to the description or drawings in place of features ('como descrito no relatório' is prohibited). Include reference numerals in parentheses after structural features when the application has drawings; the numerals do not limit the claim. Dependent claims start with the claim category word plus 'de acordo com a reivindicação N', followed by 'caracterizado por' and the additional features. Multiple dependencies are allowed ('de acordo com qualquer uma das reivindicações 1 a 3') but must not depend on other multiple dependent claims. Maintain unity of invention: all claims must be interlinked by a single inventive concept (Art. 22 LPI). Note the fee structure: each claim above the 10th incurs an excess fee, so consolidate where possible. Number claims sequentially in Arabic numerals; end each claim with a period.
constraints: Output in Portuguese
Every claim in two-part form with the mandatory expression 'caracterizado por'
Each claim is one sentence, opening with the title or its category-specific part
No references to description/drawings as a substitute for technical features
Reference numerals in parentheses when drawings exist
Dependent claims: 'de acordo com a reivindicação N, caracterizado por...'
Multiple dependents allowed, but not on other multiple dependents
Single inventive concept across all claims (Art. 22 LPI)
Prefer at most 10 claims; flag when exceeding (excess fees per claim above 10)
additions: Legal basis: Art. 22 LPI (unity), Art. 25 LPI (claims define the extent of protection and must be grounded in the description), Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024 (formal claim requirements including 'caracterizado por').
Claim scope is interpreted per Art. 41 LPI (claims interpreted in light of description and drawings) — precise characterizing features matter.

Avoid claiming subject matter excluded by Arts. 10 and 18 LPI (methods of treatment, software per se, business methods); recast as product, apparatus, use ('Uso de... caracterizado por...') or technically-effected process claims.

topUp.instruction: Draft the Resumo in formal Brazilian Portuguese per Arts. 40 and 41 of Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14 of 29 August 2024, the normative instruction that replaced IN 30/2013 with effect from 3 October 2024. Present the title of the invention as a CENTERED HEADING SEPARATE FROM THE BODY TEXT — under the current rule the title is set apart above the abstract rather than run into the first words of the paragraph, which is how the superseded IN 30/2013 required it. Follow it with a single concise paragraph summarizing the technical disclosure: the technical sector, the problem addressed, and the essence of the solution, indicating the principal use where relevant. The abstract should contain PREFERABLY between 50 and 200 words and must not exceed one page — the word range is now a preference rather than a hard limit, and the former 20-line cap has been abolished, but the one-page ceiling is real. Write it as a search-oriented technical digest that lets a searcher judge relevance quickly. Do not state merits, advantages, commercial value or speculative claims; do not use claim language ('caracterizado por' is unnecessary here), claim references, or legal phrases. Include the reference numerals of the main technical features in parentheses if drawings exist, following INPI publication practice. Remember the abstract does not define protection scope (protection is defined by the claims, Art. 41 LPI).
constraints: Output in Portuguese
Title as a centered heading separate from the abstract text (Art. 40)
Single paragraph, preferably 50-200 words, never exceeding one page
Technical summary only: sector, problem, essence of solution, principal use
No statements of merit, marketing language, claim references or legal phrasing
additions: Legal basis: Arts. 40-41 of Portaria/INPI/DIRPA no. 14/2024 (in force 3 October 2024, replacing IN 30/2013); Art. 41 LPI (abstract has no scope-defining effect).
This platform flags fewer than 50 or more than 200 words as warnings, reflecting that the range is now a preference rather than a hard limit.

diagramGenerationHints.block: Use rectangles for components and arrows for signal, data or material flow. Label blocks with reference numerals matching the Descrição Detalhada; any text inside blocks should be short Portuguese keywords only.
diagramGenerationHints.flowchart: Use standard flowchart symbols for process steps and decisions. Step labels should correspond to the claimed method steps ('Processo... caracterizado por') and use Portuguese keywords; number steps to match the description.
diagramGenerationHints.schematic: Use simplified symbols showing functional relationships in firm black lines suitable for black-and-white reproduction. Match every label to reference numerals defined in the description.
diagramGenerationHints.perspective_view: Use perspective or isometric views to show the overall structure of the apparatus. Assign a unique reference numeral to each important structural element described in the Descrição Detalhada.
diagramGenerationHints.cross_section: Use cross-sectional views with hatching to distinguish materials or components. Indicate the cutting plane on a related figure where helpful.
diagramGenerationHints.graph: Use clearly labeled axes with units in Portuguese (or SI symbols) and legends readable in black-and-white; graphs supporting experimental results strengthen sufficiency under Art. 24 LPI.
diagramGenerationHints.exploded_view: Use exploded views to show assembly relationships; each part must carry a unique reference numeral referenced in the description.

checkList.description: Ensure all figure numbers and reference numerals mentioned in the Breve Descrição dos Desenhos are defined and explained in the Descrição Detalhada da Invenção, and vice versa.
Ensure key claimed structural elements (with their parenthetical reference numerals) appear in at least one figure when drawings are present, traceable via the Breve Descrição dos Desenhos.
Ensure every feature recited after 'caracterizado por' in each claim is grounded in the Descrição Detalhada (Art. 25 LPI).
